# web-ifc 0.0.78

Unmodified browser IIFE and single-thread WASM from the official npm `web-ifc@0.0.78` package (That Open Company). MPL-2.0 license included. Source: https://github.com/ThatOpen/engine_web-ifc/tree/4310503d8618a0870c2166f101471078d528f4c1 . Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/web-ifc/-/web-ifc-0.0.78.tgz . Browser dependencies are served locally; IFC bytes are never sent to that registry.
